theorems.name: Submission.hausdorff_carrier_symmDiff_support_null
theorems.statement: ∀ {n ℓ : ℕ} {U : Set (Amb n ℓ)} (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U), (∀ x ∈ V.support, ∃ t : ℝ, 0 < t ∧ V.HasDensity x t) → (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (symmDiff V.carrier V.support) = 0
